title: Custom boot splash image not loaded from pck
body:
### Tested versions

Tested with 4.4.1 and 4.3, but only under Linux. Both exhibit the issue.

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable (2a0a14459) - Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS (Focal Fossa) - X11 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - Radeon RX 580 Series (POLARIS10, DRM 3.42.0, 5.15.0-151-generic, LLVM 12.0.0) - AMD Ryzen 7 2700X Eight-Core Processor (16 Threads)

### Issue description

I can get custom boot splash images to appear fine in the editor and when running the export in the project directory, but it doesn't show up once the executable is moved (the game otherwise runs fine though). I tried this with both an embedded PCK and an external one, and the file appears to be inside the PCK (in my game the image was also used as a texture on the end screen, and loaded fine).

The error I see when launching the executable is 

```
ERROR: Error opening file 'res://art/pbs-logo.png'.
   at: load_image (core/io/image_loader.cpp:89)
ERROR: Non-existing or invalid boot splash at 'res://art/pbs-logo.png'.  Loading default splash.
   at: setup_boot_logo (main/main.cpp:3565)
```

If I put the image at `./art/pbs_logo.png` it does show up on the boot splash screen.

[The docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_projectsettings.html#class-projectsettings-property-application-boot-splash-image) don't say the image can't be inside the PCK, so I assume this is a bug.





### Steps to reproduce

The following repository should exhibit the issue: https://github.com/domdfcoding/godot-bootsplashtest

The custom boot logo should show up when running in the editor (but not the editor window itself). It should also show up when running the exported executable in the project directory. But copying the executable to a different directory means the logo won't show up.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/domdfcoding/godot-bootsplashtest
